templates.header:
## {bot_name} automated review

This pull request was checked automatically. The review re-runs on every push and edit.
templates.verdict_pass: **Result: all checks passed.** A maintainer will review the change shortly.
templates.verdict_fail: **Result: changes requested.** One or more required checks did not pass. Please address the items marked *Fail* below.
templates.verdict_warn: **Result: passed with remarks.** No blocking problems; please review the *Warning* items below.
templates.footer: --- Automated check. Configuration: .github/parsecore-bot/config.json. Override switch: [skip-comment-check] in the PR description.

title.fail: The title must follow Conventional Commits: `type(scope): subject`, for example `fix(catch): work the hyper-dash grace period out at single precision`. Scopes: beatmap, osu, taiko, catch, mania, mods, pp, scoring, readme, docs, ci, packaging.

template.pass: The PR template is filled out.
template.fail: Please complete the PR template: provide a Summary, tick at least one Type of Change, and complete the Checklist.

parity.pass: An accuracy statement is provided for the changed calculations.
parity.fail: This PR touches code that can change a computed value, but the Accuracy section is empty or marked N/A. Say which values the change can affect, and how you checked them against the values the game awards.
parity.skip: Nothing here can change a computed value, so an accuracy statement is not required.

docs.pass: Public API changed and the docs were updated alongside it.
docs.fail: This PR adds or changes a public `def`/`class` under `parsecore/` but no docs or README were updated. If the change is user-visible, please update the relevant documentation. This is a reminder only and does not block the review.
docs.skip: No public API surface changes were detected; a docs update is not required.

comment_policy.pass: No inline comments were added to parsecore code.
comment_policy.fail: This PR adds `#` comments inside `parsecore/`. The codebase is intentionally comment-free apart from the license header; please move explanations into the PR description. Add `[skip-comment-check]` to the description if this is a false positive.

size.fail: This PR adds more than {limit} lines. Consider splitting it into smaller, focused PRs; large diffs slow review and increase parity risk.
